brief.topic: Myth: AI governance slows teams down
brief.audience: Enterprise PMs and AI programme leads

coreInsight: Risk tiers decided upfront let low-risk AI ideas ship with light checks and save full review for high-risk ones, which is faster than debating every case.

caption.opening: Governance isn’t the slow part. Debating every AI use case from scratch is.
body:
Decide risk tiers once:
→ Low risk: go ahead, with logging
→ Medium risk: a short checklist
→ High risk: full review
A short intake form sorts each new idea into a tier. Low-risk ideas stop waiting behind high-risk ones, and the review team spends its time where the risk is.
